scientific_integrity: The polynomial is proved algebraically; nineteen exhaustive small-parameter experiments are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only two-by-two matrices over finite commutative chain rings; image lengths rather than full similarity classes. Drazin-index and early nilpotent-matrix counting may cover some totals; comparison of inaccessible historical full texts and independent verification remain outstanding.
title: A uniform image-length census for square-zero two-by-two matrices over finite chain rings
